subtitle: Ox-Head

lore: Gozu and Mezu—or Ox-Head and Horse-Face—are guardians of Yomi, Izumo’s underworld. For ages, they worked together as a pair, their duties nigh identical. Since the Shattering, however, Gozu more frequently remains behind to guard the entrance to Yomi. There he welcomes the newly arrived dead, or runs them down if they should seek to escape, before delivering them below.
